Name: GiftForceMod
Author: Snowfield0
Description:
[size=5][b]强制爱Mod[/b][/size]

送礼送到一半发现村民不喜欢？那让村民受着呗！

[b][size=5]功能[/size][/b]
当你送给村民喜欢/一般/不喜欢/讨厌的礼物时，会弹出一个对话框：

「慢着慢着！这其实是个好礼物，你听我说…」 — 正经嘴炮说服，成功率随好感度提升（可配置），默认变成最爱。
「那你就受着呗！」 — 花 100g 强行塞给他，附带史莱姆暴毙音效，默认变成喜欢。
嘴炮失败？别慌，还有第二层：「拿错了换一个」或者继续「那你就受着呗！」

[b][size=5]配置[/size][/b]
config.json ：花费、成功率、音效（默认翻垃圾桶声）、嘴炮算最爱还是喜欢、搞怪算最爱还是喜欢。

[b][size=5]多语言[/size][/b]
支持中文 / English，自动跟随游戏语言。

本mod使用vibe coding编译而成。

[b]Giving a gift but halfway through you find the villager doesn't like it? Then they'll just have to take it, huh?[/b]
[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]
When you give a villager a gift they like / neutral / dislike / hate, a dialog box will pop up:
[list]
[*][b]"Wait, wait! This is actually a good gift, hear me out…"[/b] — A serious "smooth talk" option. Success rate increases with friendship (configurable). By default, the gift becomes "loved".[/*]
[*][b]"Then just take it, huh?"[/b] — Spend 100g to force the gift on them. Accompanied by a slime death sound effect. By default, the gift becomes "liked".[/*]
[/list][b]Failed the smooth talk? No worries — there's a second layer:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]"Wrong one, let me swap it."[/b][/*]
[*]Or continue with [b]"Then just take it, huh?"[/b][/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
config.json: cost, success rate, sound effect (default = garbage can lid sound), whether smooth talk counts as "loved" or "liked", whether the funny option counts as "loved" or "liked".
[b][size=5]Multi-language[/size][/b]
Supports Chinese / English. Switches automatically with the game's language.
[i]This mod was built using vibe coding. Includes AI translation notes.[/i]
